title: Fencing panels and hoardings for site boundaries
excerpt: How corrugated fencing panels and hoardings are used to close a project boundary and keep a site enclosed.
body:
Construction sites use fencing panels and hoardings to mark the boundary and screen the work. Corrugated panels can run as a continuous line or as temporary bays that move as the job changes.

When you send an enquiry, name the panel type, the run length, and whether the line is temporary or meant to stay for the project. Kredence Steel Trading confirms what is available and arranges supply for the site.

title: Mesh, Heras, and chain link for controlled access
excerpt: Weld mesh, Heras, and chain link fencing are the usual choices when a site needs temporary security and a clear access line.
body:
Weld mesh and Heras panels are used where a site needs a fence that can be stood up quickly and taken down later. Chain link is more often used for a longer perimeter around a yard or plant.

Tell us the height, the approximate length, and whether you need a gate opening. We check the fence range and reply with what can be supplied.

title: GI and PPGI coils for roofing and cladding
excerpt: Mill-finish galvanized coils and color-coated PPGI coils are the starting material for roofing sheets, cladding, and panels.
body:
GI mill-finish coils are galvanized steel supplied for fabrication and profiling. PPGI coils are pre-painted, so the color is already on the steel before it is formed into sheets or panels.

Send the product, the thickness or finish if you have it, and the quantity. Kredence Steel Trading confirms availability for coils, sheets, purlins, and the rest of the coated-metal range.
